newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mannesmann has no plans to up Vallourec stake-SBF.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann has no plans to up Vallourec stake-SBF.

text.p: German group Mannesmann Roehren Werke (MRW) has no plans to raise its equity stake in France's Vallourec, beyond the 21 percent it now controls, the Societe des Bourses Francaises (SBF) said on Thursday.

"MRW plans to remain a stable shareholder of Vallourec and does not plans to increase its stake in the capital of that company...MRW has no intention to exceed the threshold that would require it to make a public offer for the Vallourec shares," the SBF said in a statement.

MRW controls 21 percent of the capital and 20.9 percent of the voting rights of steel pipe maker Vallourec after buying Vallourec shares and bonds redeemable into shares from Usinor. It also owns 213,71 bonds reddeemable into shares.
Usinor now controls through its Sollac unit 3.53 percent of voting rights of Vallourec and 66,231 bonds redeemable in shares.
Under French stock market regulations a company must state its intentions when it exceeds the 20 percent threshold.
MRW also wants two of its representatives to sit on Vallourec's supervisory board, the SBF said.
